title: Bias and size of the generator
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be positive integers, and let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ be given. If $\varepsilon>0$ and $n\leq \varepsilon 2^\ell\leq 4n/\varepsilon$, then the probability density generated by choosing two degree-$\ell$ binary vectors uniformly is $\varepsilon$-biased, and the cardinality of the generator multiset is at most $16(n/\varepsilon)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$
